Description: "Three pre-order flow fixes: (1) After KOT save, advance to PAYMENTS tab. (2) Remove redundant Next button, rename Print KOT. (3) Book Pre-Order reads from saved bills, prints pre-order receipt, and keeps temp table alive until fulfillment."
Instruction: "1. In handlePreOrderKOTAction: after saving KOT, move to PAYMENTS tab instead of staying on KOT tab.\n2. In KOT tab buttons: remove the \"Next\" button, rename \"Print KOT\" to \"Print & Save KOT\".\n3. In \"Book Pre-Order\" button: read items from tableBills when temp table has saved items, don't remove temp table (keep it alive until fulfillment)."
